description: On the green-covered table in front of you, there’s a white AirPods charging case attached to a white charging cable. The left hand comes in and grasps the AirPods case while the right hand pinches the cable plug near the case; the right hand pulls the connector straight out as the left hand steadies the case, then the left hand shifts the case slightly left and sets it down while the right hand lets the unplugged cable rest on the table.
